title.zh: 嘉信理财全面开放加密交易，CEO称将以加密和预测市场拓展交易收入
title.en: 嘉信理财全面开放加密交易，CEO称将以加密和预测市场拓展交易收入

current_state.zh:
嘉信理财（Charles Schwab）10 月 16 日宣布，已完成 Schwab Crypto 面向零售客户的广泛推广，符合条件的客户现可通过 Schwab.com、Schwab Mobile 和 thinkorswim 直接交易比特币和以太坊。公司同时启动加密资产充值、提币功能的分阶段开放，并计划在 2026 年底前新增 Solana、Avalanche 和 Chainlink 三种资产。

首席执行官 Rick Wurster 在秋季业务更新会上表示，加密货币交易将成为公司扩大交易型收入的重要渠道，与预测市场等新业务共同提升平台对客户资产和交易行为的商业化效率。文章指出，随着 BTC、ETH 现货交易及后续 SOL、AVAX、LINK 上线，传统大型券商与加密原生交易平台之间的竞争将进一步加剧。

交易由 Paxos 提供执行和次级托管支持，费率为 0.75%，单笔交易金额介于 1 美元至 200 万美元之间，客户持仓将与股票、债券和 ETF 一同显示在嘉信现有账户体系内。提币方面，新提币地址需完成登记并经历 24 小时等待期，提币上限为每 24 小时 3 笔、每笔 5000 美元，月度充值额度最高可达 5000 万美元；服务目前不面向纽约州、路易斯安那州、美国领地及国际客户开放。嘉信称，旗下客户已持有全行业约 20% 的现货加密 ETF 资产。
current_state.en: Charles Schwab has broadly rolled out spot bitcoin and ether trading to eligible retail clients at a 0.75% fee with Paxos execution and custody, begun phased crypto deposit/withdrawal support, and plans to add Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink by end-2026 as it targets transaction revenue alongside prediction markets.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Charles Schwab has broadly rolled out spot bitcoin and ether trading to eligible retail clients at a 0.75% fee with Paxos execution and custody, begun phased crypto deposit/withdrawal support, and plans to add Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink by end-2026 as it targets transaction revenue alongside prediction markets.
updates.background_zh: 嘉信的加密布局正从 ETF 敞口延伸至现货交易和托管转账；公司目前管理约 13.33 万亿美元客户资产，拥有 4030 万个活跃经纪账户。有关该券商加密定价的报道曾将嘉信的 75 个基点费率与 E*Trade 约 50 个基点、Coinbase 约 175 个基点相比较，将此视为券商之间费率竞争的一部分。
updates.background_en: Schwab's crypto push extends from ETF exposure into spot trading and custody/transfers, and the firm manages roughly $13.33 trillion in client assets with 40.3 million active brokerage accounts. Reporting on the brokerage's crypto pricing has cited Schwab's 75 basis point fee against E*Trade at about 50 basis points and Coinbase at roughly 175 basis points, framing the move as part of a fee competition among brokerages.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次推广将嘉信存量零售客户基础接入由 Paxos 执行并次级托管的 BTC、ETH 现货订单流，后续计划上线的 SOL、AVAX 和 LINK 将把这一通道扩展至相应资产；0.75% 的费率结构会对券商与加密原生平台的费率水平形成参照。充提额度上限与部分州的排除条款，则限制了资产在嘉信账户与链上或其他平台之间自由流动的程度。
updates.market_impact_en: The rollout routes an existing retail brokerage base into spot BTC and ETH order flow executed and sub-custodied by Paxos, while the planned SOL, AVAX and LINK listings would extend that access to those assets; the 0.75% fee structure bears on fee levels across brokerage and crypto-native venues. Deposit and withdrawal caps and state exclusions limit how freely assets can move between Schwab accounts and on-chain or other venues.
